title: Remove requirement for src or srcset attribute on img element
body: Solves: https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/11313 The current spec requires an img or an alt attribute on the img element, even though the source can be provided through source elements. This PR removes that requirement to ease authoring of valid img elements. Browsers already handle img elements without src and srcset attributes. There's an existing web platform test that relies on this behavior: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/5b9051943bd631d20f1f1681778d655cbfbeceb8/html/semantics/embedded-content/the-img-element/responsive-image-select-print.html#L19 A PR for a more specific test has been added here: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/60621 A separate PR will be filed to update the complete getter steps under the corresponding issue: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/embedded-content.html#dom-img-complete - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * … * … - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/60621 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Should not require any implementation changes - [ ] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: * https://github.com/w3c/aria/pull/2221 - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: … - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
